commit:9fa644a6be2d.author: rsenapati@umass.edu
commit:9fa644a6be2d.message:
Add air-gapped Tauri desktop app with local llama.cpp inference + sqlite-vec RAG

Libbie's on-prem/air-gapped deployment: a Tauri 2 desktop client (Rust core +
React/Vite/TS webview) that reuses the web app's design system verbatim and runs
all inference locally. Nothing leaves the machine — the webview makes zero network
calls; the Rust core proxies OpenAI-compatible traffic to loopback engine ports.

- Rust core: engine lifecycle (hardware detect, engine selection, spawn/health/
  stop) for a chat and an embedding llama-server; OpenAI-compatible streaming proxy
  over a Tauri Channel; loopback-only air-gap guard; persisted config.
- Semantic RAG: nomic-embed via a 2nd llama-server -> sqlite-vec vec0 KNN
  (statically linked, on-disk, no daemon), with lexical retrieval as fallback.
  Dual citations (code line + conversation) derived from what retrieval selected.
- UI: ambient copilot (pipeline rail / code canvas / Libbie rail / Cmd-K), model
  manager + vector-index settings, streaming verdict-then-evidence answers.
- Docs: BUILD_SPEC.md (architecture, contracts, milestones, air-gap guarantees)
  + README. Verified on Windows: cargo build/test clean, tsc/vite build clean,
  end-to-end grounded answers with both chat and embedding models.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Marcus,

Before I go: the germline caller runs on GRCh37 on purpose -- do not "upgrade" it

The min-base-quality-score is 20 (see the sbatch in pipelines/germline).

Everything writes to /data/results/. The paper figures pull sample01.vcf directly.

Elena

commit:cd433637fb4c.author: rsenapati@umass.edu
commit:cd433637fb4c.message:
feat: token/cost tracking + GitHub integration (device flow), reviewed & hardened

Token & cost panel (desktop): inference.rs captures real usage for every provider
— OpenAI-compatible via stream_options.include_usage (+ llama.cpp timings for
tokens/sec), Anthropic message_start/message_delta (cumulative), chars/4 fallback
— and emits StreamEvent::Usage. A Tokens panel shows cumulative in/out tokens,
tokens/sec for local, and estimated $ for cloud from an editable pricing table.

GitHub integration (device flow, both surfaces):
- Engine: libbie_engine/github.py + `libbie github {login,repos,ingest}` — clone
  any accessible repo (incl. private/org) and ingest it into the provenance graph.
- Desktop: github.rs + github_{login,list_repos,index_repo} IPC + a Connect-GitHub
  Settings flow that clones a repo and indexes it into the RAG store to chat over.
Reqwest/httpx-direct; no octocrab/PyGithub/git2 — zero new copyleft deps.

Adversarially reviewed (64-agent workflow, 2-of-3 verification); fixes applied:
- CRITICAL: get_config no longer returns secrets to the webview — API keys and the
  GitHub token are redacted to a sentinel; set_config merges stored secrets back
  (sentinel = unchanged), so keys stay in the Rust core (mirrors the inference proxy).
- Clone safety: disable ambient git credential helpers (-c credential.helper=) so
  the askpass token can't be persisted, and --filter=blob:limit=10m --single-branch
  to bound disk use (engine + desktop).
- Pricing: unlisted cloud models now read "unpriced" instead of a misleading $0.
- Also: aggregate memory budget on repo indexing, char-count (not byte) token
  fallback, usage emitted before error, Windows askpass empty-token guard.

Air-gap governs egress throughout: offline_mode allows only Local and blocks
downloads + GitHub. Desktop copy also humanized (/humanizer). Tests: 21/21 Rust
(+ secret-redaction), 40/40 pytest (+18 github), desktop + engine builds green;
verified in the browser (web + desktop UI, air-gap gating, zero console errors).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit:9332b62eba0f.author: rsenapati@umass.edu
commit:9332b62eba0f.message:
feat(desktop): multi-provider LLM + local model picker + HF download

Users can now run chat through any provider or fully locally:
- Provider selector (config.rs ChatProvider): Local (llama.cpp/vLLM), any
  OpenAI-compatible endpoint (OpenAI/Groq/Together/Mistral/OpenRouter/local),
  or Anthropic natively. inference.rs routes one SSE loop over both wire formats
  (OpenAI delta vs Anthropic content_block_delta), with per-provider auth.
- Pick a GGUF already on disk (existing list_models) OR download one from
  HuggingFace in-app: list_hf_gguf (Hub tree API) + download_model (streamed to
  the models dir with a progress Channel; basename-only, .gguf-only).
- Cloud embeddings via the OpenAI-compatible endpoint; local/Anthropic fall back
  to the local embedder.

Security: the air-gap toggle governs egress -- offline_mode ON allows only the
Local provider and blocks downloads; set_config validates that + loopback host +
engine-binary allowlist. Loopback is still enforced for local targets; cloud
targets reach only the configured provider. Reqwest-direct throughout (research
confirmed: no maintained Anthropic Rust SDK; hf-hub/async-openai unnecessary) --
zero new copyleft deps.

UI: Settings gains a Chat provider section (base URL + key + model per provider)
and an interactive HF downloader with a progress bar; App no longer gates chat on
the local engine when a cloud provider is active.

Tests: 16/16 Rust (provider routing, air-gap-forbids-cloud, cloud-URL, loopback
URL parsing); frontend tsc + vite build clean.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit:4753d989c8b3.author: rsenapati@umass.edu
commit:4753d989c8b3.message:
feat(engine): real provenance-graph engine + eval + desktop air-gap hardening

Implement plan.md as a genuine Python engine (engine/): ingest (SLURM/HPC,
git, Slack/.eml, PDF) -> join layer (candidate generation across artifact
classes -> LLM adjudication -> commit-vs-hypothesis rule) -> JSON graph ->
7-section Inheritance Briefing, behind a two-backends-one-interface model layer
(local vLLM/llama.cpp, Anthropic API, deterministic offline mock). Typer CLI:
ingest/join/brief/eval/stats.

Permissive-only deps (pypdf not PyMuPDF/AGPL; GitPython not pygit2/GPL;
networkx, httpx, pydantic, typer). Backends validated end-to-end via httpx
MockTransport integration tests, incl. the full join through the real Anthropic
path.

Eval (plan section 2): a 143-edge hand-labelled synthetic genomics scenario
(eval_scenario/, git fixture regenerable via build_repo.py) across all 11 edge
types -> Precision 0.97 / Recall 0.95. Fixed 4 defects it surfaced: ran tz
crash, supported_by cross-paper over-linking, produced_by recall via
Param.step_ref, ran commit threshold. Remaining misses are semantic edge types
that the API adjudicator resolves.

Desktop security (desktop/src-tauri): close two air-gap-bypass vectors from the
security review -- assert_loopback now URL-parses and exact-matches the host
(kills the substring bypass) and is enforced regardless of the offline flag;
set_config validates a loopback host + engine-binary allowlist so the webview
can't redirect inference off-box or spawn an arbitrary executable.

Tests: 22/22 Python, 10/10 Rust. Full write-up in docs/IMPLEMENTATION_REPORT.md.

commit:397910f300e3.message:
Address desktop code-review feedback: structured errors, tests, CI

Rust core (desktop/src-tauri):
- Add serde-tagged AppError enum (error.rs) with Display + constructors;
  convert all IPC commands, engine, inference and vecstore from
  Result<T, String> to Result<T, AppError> so the frontend can branch on
  `kind` instead of matching message substrings.
- Degrade gracefully instead of panicking on startup: AppState.vec is now
  Optional (falls back to lexical retrieval when the index can't open), and
  lib.rs replaces build().expect() with a clean message + exit(1).
- Sanitize resolve_model against path traversal (strip non-Normal path
  components so a relative model can't escape models_dir) + tests.
- Recover from Mutex poisoning in vecstore via a lock_conn helper.

TypeScript / build:
- Extract the chat-SSE parser into sse.ts (ChatSSEParser), used by
  devStreamChat and covered by unit tests; type AppError on the TS side.
- Single source of truth for demo data in shared/demo-data, consumed by both
  apps via an @shared/* alias + re-export shims (no more hand-synced copies).
  Wired through tsconfig (both), vite.config.ts, and Turbopack root.
- Add vitest to the desktop app with tests for the SSE parser, rag.ts
  scoring/confidence heuristics, and the error helpers.
- Add .github/workflows/ci.yml: Rust (fmt/clippy/test), desktop web
  (tsc/vitest), and libbie (lint/tsc/build).
- Fix all libbie ESLint issues so the lint gate is enforcing.

Cleanup:
